title: Database out of memory
reason: The diagnosis correctly identifies the DB as the broken part, the OOM memory issue, and the api 2.4.0 sales report query as the trigger.
option_titles: Increase DB memory limit to 2 GiB
root_cause: The new sales report page (api 2.4.0) executes a heavy SQL query that sorts large joined tables, causing PostgreSQL to exceed its 1 GiB memory limit and be OOM killed (signal 9), which brings down the API and causes intermittent 503 errors.
truth: api 2.4.0 added a sales report query that makes PostgreSQL use more than its 1 GB memory limit, so it is killed (out of memory, signal 9) and keeps restarting.
